preconditions.description: Input consists of integers n (number of problems) and m (required balance), where n is between 1 and 5000 inclusive, and m is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The input is a single line containing exactly two space-separated integers n and m.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdout.strip().split()) and len(stdout.strip().split()) == n)
postconditions.description: If no valid score distribution exists, stdout is exactly '-1'. Otherwise, stdout contains exactly n space-separated integers representing a strictly increasing sequence a_1 < a_2 < ... < a_n, where each a_i is a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda a: sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) for k in range(j+1, n) if int(a[i]) + int(a[j]) == int(a[k])))(stdout.strip().split()) == m
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', the sequence a_1, a_2, ..., a_n satisfies the balance condition: the number of triples (i, j, k) with 1 ≤ i < j < k ≤ n and a_i + a_j = a_k is exactly m.
